description: Searches Spanish companies by full or partial name and returns the candidates with their tax ID (CIF), province and status. Use it when you do NOT have the tax ID of a specific company; then call get_company with the chosen tax ID. To turn a long list of names into tax IDs, use find_cif_by_name instead. Buscar empresas españolas por nombre.
name: search_companies
title: Search Spanish companies by name
